title: Which city has the most rainy days in a year?
description: Monthly average rainy days for Mangaluru, New Delhi, Port Blair and Rameswaram are used to explain the method, fill New Delhi's row, add up a year, and find the rainy season. The video ends with the city that has the most rainy days and the city that has the fewest.
teaching_notes: One idea: monthly averages of rainy days add up to a yearly count, and the highest part of a line is the rainy season. Watch for students who compare single months instead of whole years.

video_script.why: The child can read the peak months of a rainfall line and now meets a graph of rainy days, which must be added over a year.
video_script.substitution: Add the twelve monthly values of each city to get a year, and read the highest months of a line to find its rainy season.
video_script.anchor: the book's graph of the average number of rainy days in each month for four cities
video_script.payoff_line: port blair has the most rainy days and new delhi the fewest

final_answer.value: Most: Port Blair; fewest: New Delhi (about 36 days); New Delhi July to August; Rameswaram October to December
final_answer.spoken: port blair has the most rainy days, and new delhi has the fewest, about thirty six days. new delhi's rainy season is july to august, and rameswaram's is october to december

never_show: the rainiest month decides the city with the most rainy days
maths_rules: the monthly value is the average number of rainy days in that month over several years
Port Blair 125.8 days, Rameswaram 42.3 days, New Delhi about 36 days a year
New Delhi's rainy season is July and August; Rameswaram's is October to December
slip: a year is the sum of all twelve months, not the single highest month
video_script.design: One idea: add the twelve monthly values to get a year, then read the highest part of a line. The graph stays on screen all video; the five parts of the question are taken in order.
open_questions: The figure values for Port Blair and Rameswaram are not in the extracted book text, so their yearly totals (125.8 and 42.3) come from the worklist.
